mentions.name: RedwoodSDK
mentions.description: RedwoodSDK is a React framework for Cloudflare that lets developers focus on writing their software instead of managing the infrastructure it runs on. It exposes Cloudflare capabilities including compute, database, storage, queues, AI, and realtime via durable objects, and emulates them locally with a single package installation.
mentions.problem: Writing software itself is no longer the main barrier; developers get stuck dealing with infrastructure and pushing to production, which the framework aims to shortcut.
mentions.source_excerpt: RedwoodSDK is a React Framework for Cloudflare. We wanted to build something that allows people to focus on the software that they want to write, rather than the infrastructure that it runs on.
